smm2_quality.description: Image quality for /smm2 and text queries
smm2_quality.hint: Low=online thumbnail + /render tip for HD; High=direct toost render 2 images (overworld+underworld), no /render tip

image_quality.description: Image quality for image recognition results
image_quality.hint: Model needs OCR support. Low=online thumbnail + basic info; High=toost render 2 images (overworld+underworld) + basic info

enable_llm_tools.hint: When enabled, LLM can use smm2 query tools (OCR, auto query, level only, player only, random draw). When disabled, pure command mode with no token usage. Default: off.

enable_ocr.hint: When enabled, images sent by users will auto-extract level IDs and query. If no ID is extracted, normal LLM processing. Default: off.

enable_llm_auto.hint: User says 'look up xxx', auto-detects whether it's a level or player. Returns level image + full info, falls back to player if level not found.

enable_llm_course.hint: User says 'look up xxx this level'. Returns level image + full info, returns 'level not found' if not found.

enable_llm_player.hint: User says 'look up xxx this person'. Returns full player info, returns 'player not found' if not found.

enable_llm_random.hint: User says 'draw a level', 'give me a hard one', etc. Randomly draws a level of specified difficulty and returns image + info.

llm_hint.hint: Appended to each tool description to guide LLM in choosing the correct tool.
llm_hint.default: Note: when a user sends an image, you must use the smm2_image_lookup tool, do not use other query tools.
